# Terms of Service — Goblin Survey (哥布林大調查)

Status: DRAFT (policy-draft-2026-10-09). Mirrors the website page; the website renders the same source.

## 摘要（繁體中文）

- 本服務是給私人、邀請制朋友群組使用的社群表現分析工具；目前只有合成示範資料。
- 禁止偵查對手、作弊輔助，也不提供官方牌位、MMR 或 Elo 的替代品。

## 1. Service purpose

The service gives private, invite-only groups of VALORANT players transparent community statistics about their own matches: member performance statistics, shared-match comparisons, and historical team-composition suggestions. Today the website is a synthetic demonstration only.

## 2. Eligibility

In the planned approved mode you need a Riot account in good standing that you are allowed to use under Riot Games' own terms, and you must be invited to a group.

## 3. Acceptable use

- No opponent scouting: the service does not show, and you may not use it to look up, opponents' statistics before or during a match. There is no arbitrary Riot-ID lookup and no global player search.
- No cheating assistance: the service provides no real-time in-match information or instructions; Team Builder is historical, pre-/post-match planning only.
- No ranking replacement: statistics are group-internal community statistics, not an official rank, MMR, Elo, hidden rating or ladder, and must not be presented as one.
- No attempts to access other members' data without their permission, to bypass security, or to scrape the service.
- No harassment of group members based on their statistics.

## 4. Your responsibilities

Keep invite links private to the people you intend to invite, keep your own account secure, and only link a Riot account that you own.

## 5. Account linking and consent

Account linking (future, via Riot Sign On) is optional and user-initiated. Linking alone shares nothing: data collection, group visibility and public derived analytics are separate permissions, OFF by default, and can be revoked at any time. See the Privacy Policy and the account linking disclaimer.

## 6. Group and invite rules

Groups are private or invite-only. Invites are one-time and expire. Group owners and admins can invite and remove members; removing a member never grants or extends any data permission, and joining a group never grants data access.

## 7. Service availability

The service is a community project provided as is, without guaranteed uptime. Features may change or be discontinued; data sources may be unavailable or rate-limited.

## 8. Analytics limitations

Statistics are estimates from the match history a data source makes visible. That history is provider-visible only and never guaranteed to be a complete career (lifetime completeness is not claimed). Low-sample statistics are marked as insufficient. Team Fit is relative historical lineup fit, not a win probability.

## 9. Termination and revocation

You can leave a group, revoke permissions or unlink your account at any time (effects are described in the Privacy Policy). The operator may remove accounts or groups that violate these terms.

## 10. Riot Games

哥布林大調查 isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.

This product is not an official Riot Games product, and no approval by Riot Games is implied. Riot Games may change or revoke API access at any time.
